review_notes: Drafted by Claude, the same assistant building the extraction pipeline this label set will score -- NOT an independent human researcher. products.names lists thoughtbot's named services/technologies rather than product SKUs, which fits a services firm but is a judgment call worth a second look. traction.named_customers evidence is a section heading rather than a single quote naming every logo individually -- the client names come from a logo strip, not prose text, so treat this list as a reasonable reading rather than a single verbatim sentence. Independent re-check (2026-09-27, via WebFetch/WebSearch against live thoughtbot.com pages, a separate process from the original drafting and the extraction pipeline): company description, delivery-model quote, and a sample of named customers (12 of 33, including Real Chemistry, Postmates, MoMA, Vimeo, Hilton, Disney) all matched exactly. Confirmed pricing.public_plans/free_trial/revenue_model correctly stay not_found -- an independent fetch of /services explicitly found no pricing or engagement-cost information anywhere on the site. Also confirmed the site is remote-first with no stated single headquarters (a 'best company for remote workers' mention and distributed-team language, no address anywhere), supporting company_identity.headquarters' not_found rather than it being a missed field. One real correction: customers.industries was missing 'Technical and Business Assistance (TABA)', listed alongside Healthcare/Finance/Insurance/Government under the site's own industry-expertise heading -- added. Human review (Uttam, 2026-09-27): checked against the live site independently of the pipeline and of Claude; confirmed as-is, no corrections needed. This satisfies the PRD Section 12 ground-truth requirement.
